title: Gravity-driven film on an inclined plate (analytic)
description:
Steady Nusselt film: a liquid layer of thickness H on a plate inclined at beta, driven by the gravity component rho g sin(beta) along the plate (x, periodic), no-slip on the plate (y_lo) and a free, shear-free surface (slip wall on y_hi).
Analytic: u_x = G y (2H - y) / (2 mu), G = rho g sin(beta); surface speed G H^2 / (2 mu), flow rate per m of depth Q = G H^3 / (3 mu).
Line profile tab: u_profile (the half parabola, steepest at the plate, flat at the surface).
Derived values tab: u_surface (top cell centre, dx/2 below the surface; reference includes that offset; the scheme is exact, ~4e-5 is the float32 rounding bias of the steady lattice) and Q_sim (cell-centre sum, (dx/H)^2/8 = 3e-4 above Q_ref).
Sweep tab: Q_sim and u_surface versus the inclination beta_deg (15..90 degrees) with the dashed sin(beta) laws.

parameters.name: mu_f
parameters.description: dynamic viscosity of the liquid in Pa s

parameters.name: beta_deg
parameters.description: plate inclination from the horizontal in degrees; swept

parameters.name: L_ch
parameters.description: length of the periodic cell along the plate

parameters.name: G_grav
parameters.description: gravity force density along the plate in N/m^3

parameters.name: u_surface_ref
parameters.description: analytic u_x at the top cell centre (y = H - dx/2) in m/s (~1.7 mm/s at 60 degrees)

parameters.name: Q_ref
parameters.description: analytic flow rate per m of depth in m^2/s
